column1: # Root Rust tests outside the light CI tier.
# The light tier (`rust-tests-shard` on every push and pull request) runs every
# assigned test except these; the heavy tier (manual `workflow_dispatch` with
# test_tier=heavy, and every release tag) runs them all. A row is
# `<nextest binary id><TAB><test name>`, or `<binary id><TAB>*` for a whole
# binary. Rows record tests measured above about one second at opt-level 1 on
# hosted CI, so the light shards finish their tests inside three minutes.
# A light test that grows past 30 seconds fails under the ci-light profile:
# make it faster, or list it here. Keep rows sorted.
